name: shadow_tier3_projection
description: CEQR Tier 3 screening: accurate 3D shadow projection using pysolar ephemeris and UTM geometry. Analyzes representative days within the 1.5h-after-sunrise to 1.5h-before-sunset window (EST, no DST). Determines if shadows reach sensitive resources.

building_geojson.description: Building footprint geometry in GeoJSON format

building_height_ft.description: Building height in feet including all rooftop equipment

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction determines default analysis dates. NYC uses CEQR representative days.

sensitive_sites.description: Sensitive sites to check for shadow impacts. If omitted, uses default NYC Parks dataset.

analysis_dates.description: Dates for shadow analysis (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to CEQR representative days.

shadow_polygons.description: Shadow polygon for each analysis time snapshot

sites_affected.description: Sensitive sites that receive shadow, with enter/exit times and duration per analysis day

visualization.description: Interactive map showing shadow sweeps for each analysis day with sensitive sites
